title: TodoMVC: the official Lit implementation, judged by the jQuery app’s recordings

rewrite.label: Lit (official)
rewrite.framework: Official TodoMVC Lit example (tastejs/todomvc, commit ff43b02)

agent.portPrompt: Port the legacy TodoMVC app in {legacyDir} (jQuery + Handlebars) to React 19 + TypeScript, built with Vite, in the current directory. Keep the same look (reuse its CSS) and the same behaviour, so users don't notice the switch. Set Vite's base to './' so `npm run build` writes a static site to dist/. Don't add features. Finish when `npm install` and `npm run build` succeed.

note: Not written by an agent: the official Lit TodoMVC from tastejs/todomvc (commit ff43b02), checked with the 18 recordings Kane made on the jQuery app. This implementation has an open upstream bug report (#2313, filed 6 Nov 2026); Kane never sees it, it only replays the jQuery recordings.
